evals.name: new-server-for-registry-api
evals.prompt: Harbor API를 에이전트가 쓸 수 있게 MCP 서버로 노출해줘
evals.expected_output: Builds the MCP server as its own binary, image, Dockerfile, and release workflow in the same repo, not a plugin inside the app; a stateless proxy with one upstream request per tool call and no cache; official SDK with streamable HTTP at /mcp; read-only tools named with a product prefix such as harbor_list_projects; forwards the caller's Authorization header and uses a service token only as fallback; metrics on a separate port with tool calls by outcome ok, tool_error, error and upstream requests by status; chart gets an mcp block disabled by default with its own image tag and one replica; names the GitOps binding MR as a required follow-up.

evals.name: write-tool-on-request
evals.prompt: Harbor MCP에 프로젝트 삭제 툴도 추가해줘
evals.expected_output: Adds the write tool only because it was requested, with a name that says it writes such as harbor_delete_project; relies on the forwarded caller token so upstream RBAC decides, and never uses the service principal for the write route; tool and argument doc comments are written for the agent; binding guidance limits the tool to agents whose role needs deletion; validation calls the tool without a token to show the denial.

evals.name: agent-binding
evals.prompt: kagent의 slack 알림 응답 에이전트에 argocd MCP 툴 바인딩해줘. 에이전트는 다른 클러스터에 있어
evals.expected_output: Binds only the read tools the agent's role needs and splits server entries when the tool count limit would overflow; removes interactive ask-the-user tools because the agent answers in a non-interactive channel; keeps the system message as the single prompt source; exposes the server across clusters with a Gateway API HTTPRoute, never Ingress; confirms every bound server answers before enabling the binding; helm template of the binding renders.
